fullPassage: Our environment is in trouble. With the planet becoming warmer, sea levels are rising and natural disasters such as forest fires and floods are increasing. More and more waste is also being produced. Plastic, in particular, is causing problems with soil and water pollution. It is clear that humans are a major contributor to the destruction of nature. Will we be able to protect the environment from mountains of plastic? Can we stop climate change from reaching dangerous levels? Achieving these goals seems difficult. Nature, however, may have provided us with solutions to these problems. Here are three areas where changes are already happening. About fifty percent of plastic is produced for single-use products. That means the items are used just once and then discarded. Do you ever stop to think about where these plastic items go after you throw them away? Recycling can help reduce the amount of plastic in our landfills. However, less than ten percent of the world's plastic waste has been recycled so far. Often, plastic waste is moved to places where it is just dumped or burned. Furthermore, between 8 and 14 million metric tons of plastic end up in the ocean every year. This puts many marine species in danger. With this in mind, scientists are turning to mealworms. Mealworms are the larvae of a certain species of beetle. Special bacteria live inside them. These bacteria can break down plastic. This means that mealworms can actually feed on plastic. Scientists are now looking for ways to cultivate the bacteria outside of mealworms. They also want to speed up the process by which the bacteria break down plastic. This may help us keep our landfills plastic-free. Mining and other industries are causing soil pollution across the globe. Although polluted soil can be dug up and transported to a landfill, this process is expensive. Moreover, it only moves the problem to another area and does not really solve it. Fortunately, there is an eco-friendly and cost-effective way to restore polluted soil — planting willow trees. These amazing trees have extensive and well-developed root systems. As a result, they naturally extract a wide range of harmful materials from the soil. They can also grow quickly, even in soil with a high acidity level or a lot of heavy metals in it. Research on the effectiveness of using willow trees for this purpose is in development. Scientists have found that some species of willow trees are able to absorb harmful materials better than others. Therefore, this promising area should be further explored to find out which trees are the most effective. In time, we may be able to clean up our land with willow trees. Statistics show that about thirty to forty percent of people in the world drink coffee each day. The coffee-making process, however, generates used coffee grounds, which are normally sent to landfills. There, they can create a harmful greenhouse gas. Unfortunately, there's no way to stop everyone in the world from drinking coffee. However, we can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by turning used coffee grounds into biofuel. Biofuel is a natural fuel that is made from plant or animal sources. Researchers have found that they can grow algae on old coffee grounds without adding any other nutrients. If these algae are exposed to twenty hours of light and four hours of darkness each day, they eventually produce high-quality biofuel. The biofuel is renewable and sustainable, and it creates only a small amount of emissions. These are just a few solutions we can find in nature. There could be many more possible solutions to the problems we currently face. It seems that Mother Nature has given us one more chance. In return, we need to look for more ways to keep the environment healthy and clean. If we do, the future of our planet may be bright after all.

questions.passage: Our environment is in trouble. With the planet becoming warmer, sea levels are (A)[falling / rising] and natural disasters such as forest fires and floods are (B)[increasing / decreasing]. More and more waste is also being produced. Plastic, in particular, is causing problems with soil and water pollution. It is clear that humans are a major contributor to the destruction of nature. Will we be able to (C)[protect / pollute] the environment from mountains of plastic? Can we stop climate change from reaching dangerous levels? Achieving these goals seems difficult. Nature, however, may have provided us with solutions to these problems.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① rising(상승하는)+increasing(증가하는)+protect(보호하다): 지구가 더워지며 해수면이 '상승하고', 자연재해가 '증가하고', 이런 환경을 '보호할' 수 있을지 묻는 문맥에 모두 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ② falling(하락하는)은 해수면이 상승한다는 흐름과 반대
❌ ③ decreasing(감소하는)은 자연재해가 증가한다는 흐름과 반대
❌ ④ pollute(오염시키다)는 환경을 '보호하려' 한다는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: rising=상승하는, increasing=증가하는, protect=보호하다

questions.passage: About fifty percent of plastic is produced for single-use products. That means the items are used just once and then (A)[stored / discarded]. Do you ever stop to think about where these plastic items go after you throw them away? Recycling can help reduce the amount of plastic in our landfills. However, less than ten percent of the world's plastic waste has been (B)[recycled / wasted] so far. Often, plastic waste is moved to places where it is just dumped or burned. Furthermore, between 8 and 14 million metric tons of plastic end up in the ocean every year. This puts many marine species in (C)[danger / safety].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① stored(저장되는)는 한 번 쓰고 '버려진다'는 흐름과 반대
✅ ② discarded(버려지는)+recycled(재활용되는)+danger(위험): 일회용품은 한 번 쓰고 '버려지고', 플라스틱 쓰레기의 10% 미만만 '재활용되어' 왔으며, 바다에 유입된 플라스틱이 해양 종을 '위험'에 빠뜨린다는 문맥에 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ③ wasted(낭비되는)는 '재활용되어 왔다'는 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ safety(안전)는 해양 종을 '위험'에 빠뜨린다는 흐름과 반대
det.tip: discarded=버려지는, recycled=재활용되는, danger=위험

questions.passage: Mining and other industries are causing soil pollution across the globe. Although polluted soil can be dug up and transported to a landfill, this process is (A)[cheap / expensive]. Moreover, it only moves the problem to another area and does not really solve it. Fortunately, there is an eco-friendly and cost-effective way to (B)[restore / pollute] polluted soil — planting willow trees. These amazing trees have extensive and well-developed root systems. As a result, they naturally extract a wide range of harmful materials from the soil. They can also grow quickly, even in soil with a high acidity level or a lot of heavy metals in it. Research on the effectiveness of using willow trees for this purpose is in development. Scientists have found that some species of willow trees are able to (C)[absorb / release] harmful materials better than others. Therefore, this promising area should be further explored to find out which trees are the most effective.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① cheap(값싼)은 오염된 흙을 옮기는 과정이 '비용이 많이 든다'는 문맥과 반대
❌ ② pollute(오염시키다)는 오염된 토양을 '복구하는' 방법이라는 문맥과 반대
✅ ③ expensive(비싼)+restore(복구하다)+absorb(흡수하다): 흙을 옮기는 것은 '비용이 많이 들고', 버드나무를 심는 것은 토양을 '복구하는' 방법이며, 어떤 버드나무가 해로운 물질을 더 잘 '흡수하는지' 밝혀냈다는 문맥에 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ④ release(방출하다)는 해로운 물질을 '흡수한다'는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: expensive=비싼, restore=복구하다, absorb=흡수하다

questions.passage: About fifty percent of plastic is produced for single-use products. That means the items are used just once and then ①<u>discarded</u>. Do you ever stop to think about where these plastic items go after you throw them away? Recycling can help reduce the amount of plastic in our landfills. Furthermore, between 8 and 14 million metric tons of plastic end up in the ocean every year. This puts many marine species in ④<u>safety</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ safety → danger: 바다에 유입된 플라스틱이 해양 종을 '위험(danger)'에 빠뜨린다
det.analysis:
✅ ① discarded: 일회용품이 한 번 쓰이고 '버려진다(discarded)'는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② recycled: 플라스틱 쓰레기의 10% 미만만 '재활용되어(recycled)' 왔다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ dumped: 쓰레기가 그냥 '내버려지거나(dumped)' 태워진다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ safety(안전) → danger(위험): 'This puts many marine species in danger'에서 플라스틱이 해양 종을 '위험'에 빠뜨린다는 뜻이므로 danger가 맞다. safety는 정반대 ← 정답
det.tip: danger(위험) ↔ safety(안전)

questions.passage: Mining and other industries are causing soil pollution across the globe. Although polluted soil can be dug up and ①<u>transported</u> to a landfill, this process is expensive. They can also grow quickly, even in soil with a high acidity level or a lot of heavy metals in it. Research on the effectiveness of using willow trees for this purpose is in development. Scientists have found that some species of willow trees are able to ③<u>absorb</u> harmful materials better than others. Therefore, this promising area should be further ④<u>ignored</u> to find out which trees are the most effective.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ ignored → explored: 촉망받는 이 분야는 더 깊이 '탐구되어야(explored)' 한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① transported: 오염된 흙이 매립지로 '옮겨질(transported)' 수 있다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② extract: 버드나무가 토양에서 해로운 물질을 '추출한다(extract)'는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ absorb: 어떤 버드나무가 해로운 물질을 더 잘 '흡수한다(absorb)'는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ ignored(무시된) → explored(탐구된): 'this promising area should be further explored'에서 이 분야를 더 '탐구해야' 한다는 뜻이므로 explored가 맞다. ignored는 정반대 ← 정답
det.tip: explored(탐구된) ↔ ignored(무시된)

questions.passage: Statistics show that about thirty to forty percent of people in the world drink coffee each day. The coffee-making process, however, ①<u>removes</u> used coffee grounds, which are normally sent to landfills. There, they can create a harmful greenhouse gas. If these algae are ②<u>exposed</u> to twenty hours of light and four hours of darkness each day, they eventually produce high-quality biofuel. The biofuel is ③<u>renewable</u> and ④<u>sustainable</u>, and it creates only a small amount of emissions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① removes → generates: 커피 만드는 과정은 커피 찌꺼기를 '발생시킨다(generates)'
det.analysis:
❌ ① removes(제거하다) → generates(발생시키다): 'The coffee-making process generates used coffee grounds'에서 커피 과정이 찌꺼기를 '발생시킨다'는 뜻이므로 generates가 맞다. removes는 정반대 ← 정답
✅ ② exposed: 조류가 빛과 어둠에 '노출되면(exposed)' 바이오 연료를 생산한다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ renewable: 바이오 연료가 '재생 가능하다(renewable)'는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ sustainable: 바이오 연료가 '지속 가능하다(sustainable)'는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: generates(발생시키다) ↔ removes(제거하다)

det.analysis:

❌ ② tiny: 아주 작은 (관련 없음)
✅ ③ wonderful: 놀라운, 굉장한 ← 정답
❌ ④ ancient: 고대의 (관련 없음)
det.tip: These amazing trees = 이 놀라운 나무들 → amazing = wonderful(놀라운)

det.analysis:

❌ ④ equal: 동등한 (관련 없음)
det.tip: humans are a major contributor = 인간이 주요한 원인 제공자 → major = main(주요한)

questions.passage: Will we be able to protect the environment from mountains of plastic? Can we stop climate change from reaching dangerous levels? Achieving these goals seems <u>difficult</u>. Nature, however, may have provided us with solutions to these problems.

✅ ② easy: 쉬운 ← 정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 bright와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:

❌ ② loud: 시끄러운 (관련 없음)
✅ ③ gloomy: 어두운, 암울한 ← 정답
❌ ④ huge: 거대한 (관련 없음)

questions.passage:
(A) If these algae are exposed to many hours of <u>light</u> and only a few hours of darkness, they can eventually produce high-quality biofuel.
(B) The empty cardboard box was so <u>light</u> that even a small child could lift it with one hand and carry it across the room.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B) 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 light의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A)의 light는 조류가 노출되는 '빛'을 뜻하고(hours of light=빛의 시간), (B)의 light는 상자가 들기 쉬울 만큼 '가벼운'이라는 뜻임 ← 정답
❌ ② (A)는 '가벼운'이 아니라 '빛'임
❌ ③ (B)는 '밝은'이 아니라 '가벼운'임
❌ ④ (A)는 '가벼운'이 아니라 '빛'임
det.tip: light: (A) 빛(명사) / (B) 가벼운(형용사)

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"to grow or raise living things, such as plants or bacteria, in a prepared or controlled way"

det.analysis:
✅ ① cultivate(배양하다): 식물이나 박테리아 같은 생물을 통제된 방식으로 기르다 ← 정답
❌ ② discard(버리다): 필요 없는 것을 버리다
❌ ③ pollute(오염시키다): 더럽히다
❌ ④ purchase(구매하다): 돈을 주고 사다
det.tip: cultivate the bacteria = 박테리아를 배양하다 → cultivate = 배양하다

questions.passage: Research on the effectiveness of using willow trees for this purpose is in development. Scientists have __________ (find) that some species of willow trees are able to absorb harmful materials better than others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: find(동사 원형) → found: 앞에 'have'가 있으므로 'have + 과거분사' 형태의 현재완료다. find는 불규칙 동사로 과거분사가 found이므로 'have found(알아냈다)'가 되어야 한다.
det.tip: have + 과거분사(현재완료): find-found-found

questions.passage: Our environment is in trouble. With the planet __________ (become) warmer, sea levels are rising and natural disasters such as forest fires and floods are increasing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: become(동사 원형) → becoming: 'with + 명사(the planet) + 분사'의 부대상황 구문이다. 지구가 '점점 더워지는' 능동·진행의 의미이므로 현재분사 becoming으로 바꿔야 한다. 'with the planet becoming warmer'는 '지구가 더 따뜻해지면서'라는 뜻이다.
det.tip: with + 명사 + 현재분사(~ing): ~가 …하면서

questions.passage: Recycling can help reduce the amount of plastic in our landfills. However, less than ten percent of the world's plastic waste has been recycled so far. Often, plastic waste is moved to places where it is just dumped or burned. Furthermore, between 8 and 14 million metric tons of plastic end up in the ocean every year. This puts many __________ in danger. With this in mind, scientists are turning to mealworms. Mealworms are the larvae of a certain species of beetle.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① famous writers(유명한 작가): 바다·플라스틱 문맥과 무관
❌ ② old computers(오래된 컴퓨터): 문맥과 무관
❌ ③ empty bottles(빈 병): 구체적 쓰레기 품목일 뿐 위험에 빠지는 대상이 아님
✅ ④ marine species(해양 종): 매년 바다로 유입되는 플라스틱이 많은 '해양 종'을 위험에 빠뜨린다는 문맥에 적절 ← 정답
det.tip: end up in the ocean → puts many marine species in danger: 해양 종을 위험에 빠뜨리다

questions.passage: Statistics show that about thirty to forty percent of people in the world drink coffee each day. The coffee-making process, however, generates used coffee grounds, which are normally sent to landfills. There, they can create a harmful greenhouse gas. Unfortunately, there's no way to stop everyone in the world from drinking coffee. However, we can reduce __________ by turning used coffee grounds into biofuel. Biofuel is a natural fuel that is made from plant or animal sources. Researchers have found that they can grow algae on old coffee grounds without adding any other nutrients. If these algae are exposed to twenty hours of light and four hours of darkness each day, they eventually produce high-quality biofuel.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① electricity bills(전기 요금): 커피 찌꺼기·바이오 연료 문맥과 무관
❌ ② working hours(근무 시간): 문맥과 무관
❌ ③ water supplies(물 공급): 문맥과 무관
✅ ④ greenhouse gas emissions(온실가스 배출): 커피 찌꺼기를 바이오 연료로 바꿈으로써 '온실가스 배출'을 줄일 수 있다는 문맥에 적절 ← 정답
det.tip: reduce greenhouse gas emissions by turning used coffee grounds into biofuel: 온실가스 배출을 줄이다
